span.p:
┌─────────────┬──────────────┬────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Scenario │ Resolution │ Implementation │
├─────────────┼──────────────┼────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Same key, │ Last Write │ Timestamp from each region's clock │
│ both dirty │ Wins (LWW) │ (drift tolerance: 100ms) │
│ Same user, │ Causal │ Track version vector per user │
│ two fields │ ordering │ Flush must respect causal order │
│ Counter │ Merge (SUM) │ Each flush is delta, not absolute │
└─────────────┴──────────────┴────────────────────────────────────┘
